compatibility_changes: Windows default defines __clang__ plus the three Clang version markers.
Clang forward record tag alignment and packing are retained on Windows as on other Clang profiles.
limits: No complete compiler conformance claim. Profiles select supported semantics, not a compiler subprocess or installed version.
Predefined compatibility versions remain GNU4.2.1 and Clang4.0; target flags/features remain explicit and bounded.
Clang-preprocessed zstd still rejects __bf16; neither source nor headers were rewritten.
Source-level enum layout attributes remain unsupported, while the independent target layout API supports their layout.
No benchmark comparison is inferred from successful or rejected source checks.
Archived modulo-five fuzz campaigns keep their recorded selector contract; new harnesses use modulo seven.
